# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 15 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** God Saves the Poor and Shelters the Devout

---

**15:1** In my distress I called on the name of the LORD;
I called on the God of Jacob, and he saved me.

**15:2** For you, O God, are the hope and refuge of the poor —
who but you will save the poor and the weak?

**15:3** You will hear the prayer of the poor, O LORD;
your words are right, O God — you will not cut off the hope of those who trust in you.

**15:4** When you are praised, who could have any cause to fear?
For all that you have made will praise you when you sit in judgment.

**15:5** For the devout are in your hands;
your hand is the hand that saves — you will never abandon them.

**15:6** The fear of the LORD is over the righteous;
they will not stumble in darkness.

**15:7** The devout of the LORD will not be afraid of the dark;
they will lift up hymns of praise, singing the name of their God.

**15:8** And the LORD will hear the prayer of those who love him;
when they call out, he will not turn them aside.

**15:9** Blessed is the LORD who shows mercy to those who truly love him!

**15:10** But sinners will be swept away into eternal destruction —
no memory of them will ever be found again.

**15:11** But the mercy of the LORD is over those who love him in truth;
and the LORD will come to the aid of his righteous ones.

**15:12** For our refuge is in the LORD our savior forever;
the righteous will not be moved by the threats of nations —

**15:13** they walk in the fear of God,
for God himself is the protector of the weak.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering prioritizing poetic force and contemporary resonance.*
